title: Custody Event
description: Lots becoming parts: a GS1 EPCIS 2.0 TransformationEvent in which input lots (sheet, plate, section, bar) are cut, formed or joined into output parts or kits, so a fabricated part traces to the lots it was made from. Lots are named as lot-level classes (LGTIN) or instances with quantities in UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20 units. Shipping and receiving, with transport mode and distance, are material intake events. Every instance must also validate against GS1's EPCIS 2.0.1 JSON Schema; this profile only narrows it.

jobRef.description: The job response the transformation was recorded in, by its identifier in the shop's plant-floor records.

operations.description: The job's operation sequence numbers the event covers.
